description:
Change the status of an issue. This tool can be used to change the status of an issue to "accept", "falsepositive" or to "reopen" an issue.
An example request could be: I would like to accept the issue having the key "AX-HMISMFixnZED"
You can optionally add a comment to explain your triage decision.

comment.description: An optional comment explaining the status change

key.description: The key of the issue which status should be changed

status.description: The new status of the issue

name: change_sonar_issue_status

description: Find SonarQube projects in your instance. Supports searching by project name or key. Use this first when projectKey is unknown - most other tools require the project key from this response.

pageIndex.description: An optional 1-based page index. Defaults to 1.

pageSize.description: An optional page size. Must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 500. Defaults to 500.

q.description: An optional search query to filter projects by name (partial match) or key (exact match).

name: search_my_sonarqube_projects

description: Search for issues (bugs, vulnerabilities, code smells) in my projects. Filter by severities=['HIGH','BLOCKER'] for critical issues, impactSoftwareQualities=['SECURITY'] for security, issueStatuses=['OPEN'] to exclude resolved.

branch.description: Branch name for branch-based analysis. Discover names with list_branches. For pull request analysis, use pullRequest instead.

files.description: An optional list of component keys (files, directories, modules) to filter issues

impactSoftwareQualities.description: An optional list of software qualities to filter by

inNewCodePeriod.description: Only return issues in the new code period. Requires exactly one entry across projectKeys and files

issueKey.description: An optional list of issue keys to fetch specific issues

issueStatuses.description: An optional list of issue statuses to filter by. Note: IN_SANDBOX is valid only for SonarQube Server

pageIndex.description: An optional 1-based page index. Defaults to 1.

pageSize.description: An optional page size. Must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 500. Defaults to 100.

projectKeys.description: An optional list of SonarQube project keys to look in

pullRequest.description: Pull request key/ID in SonarQube for PR-decorated analysis. Use list_pull_requests to discover valid keys. For branch-based analysis (long-lived or short-lived without PR), use branch instead. Must be the SonarQube PR key, not a git branch name.

severities.description: An optional list of severities to filter by

tags.description: An optional list of issue tags to filter by. Tags are lowercase, e.g. ['security','convention']

name: search_sonar_issues_in_projects

files.description: An optional list of file paths to filter Security Hotspots

hotspotKeys.description: Comma-separated list of specific Security Hotspot keys to retrieve. Required unless projectKey is provided.

onlyMine.description: If true, only Security Hotspots assigned to the current user are returned

pageIndex.description: An optional 1-based page index. Defaults to 1.

pageSize.description: An optional page size. Must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 500. Defaults to 100.

projectKey.description: The key of the project or application to search in. Required unless hotspotKeys is provided.

pullRequest.description: Pull request key/ID in SonarQube for PR-decorated analysis. Use list_pull_requests to discover valid keys. For branch-based analysis (long-lived or short-lived without PR), use branch instead. Must be the SonarQube PR key, not a git branch name.

resolution.description: Filter by resolution (when status is REVIEWED)

sinceLeakPeriod.description: If true, only Security Hotspots created since the leak period (new code period) are returned

name: search_security_hotspots

description: Get detailed information about a specific Security Hotspot, including rule details, code context, flows, and comments.

hotspotKey.description: The key of the Security Hotspot to retrieve

name: show_security_hotspot

description:
Change the status of a Security Hotspot to review it. When marking as REVIEWED, you must specify a resolution.
- TO_REVIEW: Mark the Security Hotspot as needing review
- REVIEWED: Mark the Security Hotspot as reviewed with one of these resolutions:
  * FIXED: A fix has been implemented
  * SAFE: Reviewed and determined to be safe
  * ACKNOWLEDGED: Acknowledged as a risk but accepted
You can optionally add a comment to explain your review decision.

comment.description: An optional comment explaining the review decision

hotspotKey.description: The key of the Security Hotspot to update

resolution.description: The resolution when status is REVIEWED. Required if status is REVIEWED

status.description: The new status of the Security Hotspot

name: change_security_hotspot_status

description: Analyze a file or code snippet to identify code quality and security issues. Optionally provide a code snippet to filter issues — only issues within the snippet will be reported (snippet location is auto-detected). Always specify the language and the file scope (MAIN or TEST) for more accurate results. This tool is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. For richer, cross-file analysis, connect SonarQube for IDE (enables analyze_file_list) or enable Vortex analysis (run_advanced_code_analysis).

codeSnippet.description: Code snippet to filter issues - must match content within the analyzed file

projectKey.description: Optional SonarQube project key (e.g. my_project). Uses organization default quality profiles when omitted. Use search_my_sonarqube_projects when the key is unknown.

scope.description: Scope of the file: MAIN or TEST (default: MAIN)

name: analyze_code_snippet
